title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] In the Winter Age of RPGs

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】ＲＰＧ冬の時代に
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] In the Winter Age of RPGs

blocks.source: テストプレイの経過
blocks.translation: Test Play Progress

blocks.source: テストプレイのクリア報告をいくつか頂きましたが、やはりいくつかバグがあるようです。特に「魔物シンボルがいるマップ上で、一部の処理を実施時にタイミングが悪いとフリーズする」なんてのは、ちょっとヤバげです。
blocks.translation: I've received several reports of people completing the test play, but there seem to be a few bugs after all. In particular, the issue where the game freezes if the timing is bad when certain processes are performed on a map with monster symbols is rather alarming.

blocks.source: こういう再現性の低いものは自分だけでは発見が難しいので、やっぱり人に頼ってよかったなあと思います。まことにありがたいことです。
blocks.translation: Things with low reproducibility like this are difficult for me to find on my own, so I'm glad I decided to rely on other people after all. I am truly grateful.

blocks.source: その他、頂いた意見についても参考にさせて頂く予定です。今のところ、修正に時間を要するようなバグもないので、順調に公開までいけるかなあと。
blocks.translation: I also plan to take the other feedback I received into consideration. So far, there are no bugs that seem to require much time to fix, so I think things should proceed smoothly through to the release.

blocks.source: ＲＰＧ冬の時代
blocks.translation: The Winter Age of RPGs

blocks.source: テストプレイをお願いしている間、わりと手持ち無沙汰だったので、久々に市販ＲＰＧでもやろうと思い立ちました。なんせ、制作に専念していたため市販ＲＰＧは長いことやっていません。
blocks.translation: While I was asking people to test-play the game, I had relatively little to do, so I decided to play a commercial RPG for the first time in a while. Since I had been focusing entirely on development, I hadn't played a commercial RPG in a long time.

blocks.source: 最近やった市販ＲＰＧを挙げてみると
blocks.translation: Looking at the commercial RPGs I've played recently:

blocks.source: テイルズオブグレイセスｆ（2009/12/10発売）
blocks.translation: Tales of Graces f (released 2009/12/10)
Final Fantasy XIII (released 2009/12/17)

blocks.source: ゼノブレイド（2010/06/10発売）
blocks.translation: Xenoblade (released 2010/06/10)

blocks.source: アークライズファンタジア（2010/07/20発売）
blocks.translation: Arc Rise Fantasia (released 2010/07/20)

blocks.source: ポケモンブラック（2010/09/18発売）
blocks.translation: Pokémon Black (released 2010/09/18)

blocks.source: 英雄伝説 碧の軌跡（2011/9/29発売）
blocks.translation: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure (released 2011/9/29)

blocks.source: ……全然最近じゃありませんね。
blocks.translation: ...Those aren't recent at all.

blocks.source: きっと、僕は世間からすっかり置いていかれているはずです。さっそく、その間に発売したＲＰＧとその評判などを眺めてみます。よさそうな作品があれば購入も検討しましょう。
blocks.translation: I'm sure I've been completely left behind by the world. I'll take a look at the RPGs released during that time and see what kind of reputations they have. If there are any promising titles, I'll consider buying them.

blocks.source: ＤＱ
blocks.translation: DQ

blocks.source: １０はネトゲなのでスルー。１１はまだ～？
blocks.translation: I'll skip X, since it's an online game. Is XI out yet?

blocks.source: ……えっ次は無双系アクション？
blocks.translation: ...Huh? The next one is a Musou-style action game?

blocks.source: ＦＦ
blocks.translation: FF

blocks.source: １４はネトゲ(ry
blocks.translation: XIV is an online game (and so on)

blocks.source: １３の派生がたくさんありますが、そこまで１３が好きなわけでも……。
blocks.translation: There are lots of spin-offs of XIII, but it's not like I love XIII that much...

blocks.source: それよりＦＦ１３ヴェルサス改めＦＦ１５は何年開発するつもりなんですかねえ？ この完成しなさには僕も敵いません。
blocks.translation: More importantly, how many years do they plan to spend developing Final Fantasy XIII Versus—now renamed Final Fantasy XV? Even I can't compete with how long this is taking to finish.

blocks.source: テイルズオブ
blocks.translation: Tales of

blocks.source: 最新作はエクシリア１～２かな？ 評判はちょっと微妙なんでスルーでいいかな。
blocks.translation: I guess the latest entries are Xillia 1 and 2? The reception seems a little iffy, so I think I'll skip them.

blocks.source: 英雄伝説
blocks.translation: The Legend of Heroes

blocks.source: 最新作は閃の軌跡１～２。評判は(ry
blocks.translation: The latest entries are Trails of Cold Steel 1 and 2. The reception is (and so on)

blocks.source: とはいえ、こっちは軌跡シリーズの途中までやっているのでその内時間があれば。
blocks.translation: That said, I've played partway through the Trails series, so I'll get to them if I have time eventually.

blocks.source: ポケモン
blocks.translation: Pokémon

blocks.source: Ｘ・Ｙが発売。評判は悪くなさそうだけど、ポケモンはマンネリ色も強いから優先して買うほどでも。というか、そもそも３ＤＳを持っていない。
blocks.translation: X and Y have been released. The reception doesn't seem bad, but Pokémon has also become rather repetitive, so it's not worth making them a priority purchase. Besides, I don't even own a 3DS.

blocks.source: ブレイブリーデフォルトとかも気になるけど。３ＤＳを(ry
blocks.translation: Bravely Default also looks interesting, though. But I don't have a 3DS (and so on)

blocks.source: ※ちなみにネトゲとか洋ゲーでも絶対に駄目というわけではないです。ただテンポよく進み、かつ綺麗に終わるゲームが好きなので、他を差し置いて積極的にやりたいとは思わないのですよね。
blocks.translation: ※Incidentally, it's not that I absolutely refuse to play online games or Western games. I simply like games that progress at a good pace and end neatly, so I don't feel particularly motivated to choose them over everything else.

blocks.source: ……大して流行った作品がないので、思ったほど置いてかれてませんでした。
blocks.translation: ...There haven't been many particularly popular titles, so I wasn't as far behind as I thought.

blocks.source: できの良し悪し以前に、そもそもまともにＲＰＧが発売されていないのが痛いです。ＰＳ２時代から明らかに本数が減少傾向にあったのは分かっていましたが、それでも何だかんだで評判作が出ていたはず。ここまでの空白期間はなかったような気がします。
blocks.translation: Regardless of their quality, the real problem is that hardly any proper RPGs have been released in the first place. I knew the number of releases had clearly been declining since the PlayStation 2 era, but even so, there should still have been well-received titles appearing here and there. I don't think there has ever been such a long empty period.

blocks.source: とはいえ、今年はペルソナ５やらサガ新作やら、情報は出てきているようなので期待をしておきます。今は仕方ないので、まずは過去の良作からプレイしています。
blocks.translation: That said, information about Persona 5 and a new SaGa game seems to be coming out this year, so I'll remain hopeful. For now, since there's nothing I can do, I'm playing some of the great games from the past.

blocks.source: そんなわけで……
blocks.translation: And so...

blocks.source: 毎年のように良作が発売されていたＳＦＣ時代が懐かしい。そんなＲＰＧ冬の時代を嘆く同志達のためのミスティックスターです。ＳＦＣの新作ＲＰＧをやるような気持ちで遊んで頂ければ。
blocks.translation: I miss the SNES era, when great games were released almost every year. Mystic Star is for fellow RPG fans lamenting this winter age of RPGs. I hope you enjoy it with the feeling of playing a new SNES RPG.

blocks.source: もちろん「ＳＦＣなんてやったことないよ」っていう世代も歓迎です。
blocks.translation: Of course, generations who say, "I've never played an SNES game before," are welcome too.

blocks.source: ２０年前、ＳＦＣのＲＰＧツクールを初めて手にとった時にＤＱやＦＦみたいな長編ＲＰＧを作りたいと夢を見たものです。すぐに現実の壁にぶち当たることになったわけですが、それでも少しでも理想に近づきたくて努力してきました。
blocks.translation: Twenty years ago, when I first picked up RPG Maker for the SNES, I dreamed of making a long-form RPG like Dragon Quest or Final Fantasy. I soon ran headfirst into the wall of reality, but even so, I've continued working hard to get as close to my ideal as possible.

blocks.source: それから大学時代までは結構、いい感じに作品を完成できていました。しかし、就職して社会人になったら忙しさに一時はもう駄目かもしれないと思いました。
blocks.translation: Up through my university years, I was able to complete projects fairly successfully. However, once I found a job and entered the working world, I became so busy that for a while I thought I might not be able to do it anymore.

blocks.source: ですが、そんな苦難を乗り越えた末、この作品は初めて自分の理想に到達したと言えます。
blocks.translation: However, after overcoming those hardships, I can say that this work has reached my ideal for the first time.

blocks.source: 人の期待に応えられるかどうかは知りませんが、自分の期待には応えました。なので、これでつまらなかったらどうしようもないという感じです。
blocks.translation: I don't know whether it will live up to other people's expectations, but it has lived up to mine. So if even this turns out to be boring, I feel there's nothing more I can do.

blocks.source: たぶん、これが最後のミスティックスター開発記録となる予定ですので、よろしくお願いします。
blocks.translation: This will probably be the final Mystic Star Development Log, so I hope you'll look forward to it.
